product.olivetti-notebook-s25.summary: The monochrome S25 extended the Olivetti 1. Notebook range.
product.olivetti-notebook-s25.history: MCmicrocomputer documented the expansion of the Olivetti 1. portable line with the S25 and S25/C in May 1992.
product.olivetti-notebook-s25.architectu: The display distinguished the versions. In November, MCmicrocomputer described the same 386SX base, 80 MB disk and VGA compatibility with different panels.
product.olivetti-notebook-s25.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-notebook-s25.limitation: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-notebook-s25.brochure-i: VintAds, Olivetti Notebook S25 brochure record, 1992.
